fields.name: Token
fields.description: 48-char random invite token; the secret a guest link carries

fields.name: Label
fields.description: Who or what this guest link is for (admin-facing only)

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Role slug the link holder browses as (e.g. dataviewer, clouduser); empty means plain guest

fields.name: CvId
fields.description: The one CV id this link shares; empty means nothing is shared and the guest sees an empty state

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: When the link stops working; empty means no expiry

fields.name: Revoked
fields.description: True once the admin revokes the link
